requirements: Authorized Ed25519 signature over the canonical ARCHANGEL/v0 message
Peer allow-list verification before X25519/WireGuard binding
Separate operator approval and public-scope review

exclusions: ROOT accounts, sessions, passwords, member action plans, and progress states
provider records, applications, eligibility decisions, case information, and emergency context
private addresses, properties, locations, worksites, material yards, and device telemetry
unverified operational records or invented signatures, CIDs, and ledger references
